content.text: Tamimaya hetheh thai awh haw.
Talai van kaawm e pueng thai awh haw.
Ka rahnoum hoi ka rasang,
ka tawnta hoi ka mathoe pueng cungtalah thai awh haw.
Ka kâko ni lungangnae lawk a dei han.
Hahoi, ka lungthin khopouknae ni panuethainae a poe han.
Cingthuilawk koe lah ka hnâ ka pakeng vaiteh,
lawk ka ru ka dei e hah, ka ratoung hoi ka cai sak han.
Thoenae ni na kalup navah,
bangkongmaw hnin kathout nah ka taki han.
Ahnimouh teh amamae hnopai hah a kâuep awh teh,
a tawnta awh e dawk ka kâoup awh nakunghai,
amamae hmaunawngha apinihai ratang thai mahoeh.
Ratangnae phu Cathut koe poe thai hoeh.
Ahnimae hringnae ratang nahane aphu apap poung.
Hatdawkvah, nâtuek hai poe hane khout thai hoeh.
Ratang pawiteh, a yungyoe a hring han doeh.
Pawknae koe phat mahoeh.
Tamilungkaang hai a due.
Hot patetvanlah, tamipathu hoi
bangpuibangpa lah kaawm hoeh e hai a due van.
Hahoi, hnopainaw hah ayânaw hanelah
a ceitakhai awh tie hah a hmu awh.
A lungthung hoi teh amamae im hah
a yungyoe kangning hanelah a pouk awh.
A onae im hah se pueng dawk kangning hanelah a pouk awh.
Amamae ram hah a min a phu sak awh.
Hatei, tami heh bari lah ao eiteh, kangning hoeh.
Kahmakatanae koe ka phat e saring patetlah doeh ao.
Hethateh tamipathunaw e lamthung doeh.
Hahoi, a catounnaw hai a dei awh e patetlah ao awh.
A duenae hmuen koelah ceikhai e tu patetlah ao awh.
Duenae ni a ca awh han.
Tamikalannaw ni khodai toteh a uk awh han.
A onae hmuen koehoi ahlanae hmuen koe
a takthai meihawinae naw teh,
phuen vah koung a pawk han.
Hatei, ka hringnae hateh,
Cathut ni phuen thaonae koehoi a ratang han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ama ni na coe han.
Tami buet touh a tawnta teh, a imthungkhu bawilennae hoi
hoehoe a kâthap navah, taket hanh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, a due toteh banghai sin thai kalawn mahoeh.
A bawilennae ni hai kâbang sin kalawn mahoeh.
A hring nathung yawhawi kacoepounge lah kâpouk nakunghai,
na tawnta dawkvah tami ni ka pholen nakunghai,
a napanaw ceinae koe a cei van vaiteh,
nâtuek hai kho ang hmawt thai awh mahoeh toe.
Tami ni bari e lah ao eiteh, panuethainae ka tawn hoeh e teh,
saring kahmakata e patetlah doeh ao.
